verdict.rationale: PayPal has shipped an official MCP server that explicitly lets merchants use natural language with MCP clients, plus an Agent Toolkit enabling function-calling integration with LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and MCP — directly enabling natural-language operation by AI agents. This is confirmed via first-party docs and a live probe of the MCP server page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that natural-language commands actually work reliably in practice, and broader community corroboration beyond vendor docs and repo description.
